text: Professional Overview:Marine science is a disciline that studies the natural phenomena, properties and changing patterns of the ocean, as well as environmental and resource issues related to the ocean. This major integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as physics, chemistry, biology, and geology to explore the mysteries of the ocean and solve practical problems in Marine development and environmental protection.Basic theory course:Fundamentals of Mathematics and Physics: Advanced Mathematics, Linear Algebra, Probability Theory and Mathematical Statistics, College Physics (mechanics, Electromagnetism, etc.), providing tools for quantitative analysis of Marine phenomena.Fundamentals of Chemistry: Inorganic Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Marine Chemistry, which study the material composition of seawater, chemical equilibrium and chemical processes in the ocean.Biological Foundation: General Biology, Cell Biology, Ecology, understanding the structure and function of Marine organisms and the operation mechanism of Marine ecosystems.
